journey.label: The Journey
journey.item1_desc: Ancient palm trees carrying thousands of years of bounty, growing in the fertile oasis soil and producing the world's finest dates.
journey.item2_desc: Olive trees living for over a thousand years, producing pure liquid gold oil, full of history and the scent of the earth.
journey.item3_desc: Rare natural herbs growing in oasis orchards, hand-gathered by craftswomen carrying nature's secret from generation to generation.
journey.item4_desc: From fresh spring waters to pure desert soil, every product carries the authentic spirit of Siwa and the unique purity of its nature.

philosophy.label: Philosophy
philosophy.desc: We tell the story of a land where civilizations lived, and bring you a piece of the oasis magic. Every product is made by the hands of Siwa people, in a pure heritage style, far from factories and machines. We believe authenticity is inherited, not manufactured.
philosophy.caption: From the heart of the desert... life was born

fallback_products.p1_desc: Carefully selected Lab dates weighing 1 kg, natural sweetness and high nutritional benefits.

fallback_products.p3_desc: Delicious Siwa Maamoul made with natural Siwa dates.
fallback_products.p4_desc: Authentic Siwa olive oil 1 liter, for health and immunity.
fallback_products.p5_desc: Siwa apple olives pickled using natural traditional methods.
fallback_products.p6_desc: Half a liter bottle of first cold pressed Siwa olive oil.
